facts.description: A real-time force shield effect built with React Three Fiber, Three.js, and custom GLSL shaders. This repository is a free open-source resource for the creative development community.

research.name: Force Shield VFX
research.note: Hand-written GLSL force shield sphere with hex cells and a glowing rim, shown in a live 3D playground with tweakable controls.
research.license: none (no license file in the repository)

effects: hexagonal cell force shield with cyan fresnel rim glow, rendered with custom GLSL
live 3D playground with Leva control panel, bloom and Default/Droideka presets
